MANDARIN CHINESE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MANDARIN CHINESE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Phonological Awareness ● Sound Discrimination ● Ton.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Phonological Awareness ● Sound Discrimination ● Ton.
